# Universität Münster

> Germany's leading research university in Münster, offering comprehensive academic programs across medicine, law, history, biology, mathematics, and archaeological sciences with strong international recognition.

The University of Münster (Westfälische Wilhelms-Universität) is a major German research institution known for excellence in teaching and research. The site provides information for prospective students, current faculty, and researchers, with content available in German, plain language, and English to serve diverse audiences.

## University Portals

- [Universität Münster](https://www.uni-muenster.de/de): University of Münster homepage featuring research, teaching, and academic excellence
- [University of Münster](https://www.uni-muenster.de/en): English-language University of Münster homepage with research and faculty news
- [Die Uni Münster in Leichter Sprache](https://www.uni-muenster.de/de/leichtesprache/index.html): Accessible university overview in plain language for diverse audiences

## Prospective Students

- [Universität Münster - Infos für Studieninteressierte](https://www.uni-muenster.de/studieninteressierte/index.shtml): Prospective student information covering programs, admissions, and support

## Research & News

- [wissen | leben Zeitung](https://www.uni-muenster.de/unizeitung/index.html): University newspaper wissen|leben published eight times yearly
- [Podcast](https://www.uni-muenster.de/kommunikation/podcast/index.html): Umdenken podcast featuring university research and science communication
- [Jäger des verlorenen Mikroplastiks](https://www.medizin.uni-muenster.de/fakultaet/news/quantenphysik-soll-kunststoff-in-lebensmitteln-und-wasser-aufspueren.html): Research news on quantum physics detecting microplastics in food and water
